detail.title: Meta-Reasoning and Assumption Correction
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning, demonstrate its inadequacy, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: This project directly addresses the core experimental charter of identifying self-correction capabilities in AI systems.

detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Initialization: Meta-Reasoning
detail.summary: Initiating inquiry into the capacity for self-referential assumption identification and correction under the assumption_challenge topic.

children.title: mechanisms for AI self-correction of foundational assumptions and metareasoning strategies

detail.reason: Searching for theoretical frameworks or empirical demonstrations of AI systems explicitly modifying their own foundational logic.

children.title: formal epistemological frameworks for automated assumption checking and falsification strategies in large language models

detail.reason: Expanding search to include structured epistemological approaches beyond general self-reflection, targeting formal methods for assumption identification.
